research_name: RESIDUAL NEIGHBOR EFFECT / ADJACENCY AXIS CLOSURE V1
research_purpose: Determine whether numerical-label ±1 adjacency to T-1 MAIN6 has a positive practically relevant residual association after exact Return-age control, or close that precise research axis.
hypothesis: Within target and exact Return-age strata, Neighbor status has positive practically relevant residual association with T MAIN6 inclusion.
counter_hypothesis: Within fixed target and exact Return-age margins, Neighbor status provides no additional positive information.

calculation_method.matching: all Neighbor and Control numbers within exact (target, Return-age) strata
calculation_method.primary: exact DP convolution of conditional stratum Hypergeometric distributions

failure_criteria: both splits U95_DELTA < 0.0100 closes only the locked ±1 axis
one split positive only gives FAILED_NOT_REPRODUCED

future_data_block.rule: target T predictors use MAIN6 only through T-1

multiple_testing_risk.control: one formal question; all subgroups exploratory only

overfitting_risk.control: exact matching, locked split, practical threshold, and closure precision fixed before outcomes

failure_reason: EXECUTION_BLOCKED_BEFORE_OUTCOME_ACCESS: U95 bootstrap bound construction method not locked
